## Content review checklist

- [ ] Plain language (short sentences, simple words)
- [ ] No new facts without a source or a `:todo[...]`
- [ ] Clinical pages: `needs_clinical_review` is `false` only after a clinician read it, and `last_reviewed_by` / `last_reviewed_on` are filled in
- [ ] English meaning changed? `version` went up by 1 (translations will be flagged as out of date)
- [ ] Phone numbers / hours changed in `content/data/*.yaml`, with `verified: true` only if confirmed
- [ ] Checked the preview build (Actions → this run → "reports" for the TODO list and screenshots)
